pyqgis_plugin.name: Geodata: Vektor (Lantmäteriet)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Search and download open vector data from Lantmäteriet's STAC-vektor service.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Search and download open vector data directly from Lantmäteriet's (the Swedish mapping, cadastral and land registration authority) STAC-vektor service: Byggnader (buildings), Marktäcke (land cover), Fastighetsindelning (cadastral boundaries), Belägenhetsadresser (addresses), Ortnamn (place names) and Kommun/lan/rike (municipality/county/country). Independent plugin, not developed by Lantmäteriet. Sibling plugin to Geodata: Ortofoto & höjd (Lantmäteriet), which covers orthophoto and elevation data. Search works with any valid key; download requires a system account that has ordered the right product on Geotorget. Login goes through QGIS' own Authentication Manager (OAuth2 client credentials) - the plugin does not store any credentials itself. Covers Sweden only. The user interface is in Swedish; see the README for an English explanation of every dialog and message. STAC-karta (raster maps) is not offered: its only open collection is not tiled by area and Lantmäteriet's own product page for it points to a plain FTP mirror instead of API access, see the README for details. Downloaded layers are styled with Lantmäteriet's own official QGIS symbology where available (currently Fastighetsindelning and Marktäcke); a bundled font (LMTopografisymboler, downloaded from Lantmäteriet's own product documentation) is registered for the QGIS session only, never installed system-wide, see the README for details and license note.
